import pytest
from target import unescapeHTML

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "input_str, expected",
    [
        (None, None),
        ("", ""),
        ("plain text", "plain text"),
        ("&", "&"),
        ("a & b", "a & b"),
        ("<div>", "<div>"),
        (""Hello"", '"Hello"'),
        ("Multiple & entities <here>.", "Multiple & entities <here>."),
        # malformed entities that contain an extra '&' before the terminating ';'
        ("&abc&def;", "&abc&def;"),
        ("Start &abc&def; end", "Start &abc&def; end"),
        ("& &abc&def; <", "& &abc&def; <"),
        # entity-like strings without a terminating semicolon should remain unchanged
        ("&incomplete", "&incomplete"),
        ("&amp without semicolon", "&amp without semicolon"),
    ],
)
def test_unescapeHTML_behaviour(input_str, expected):
    assert unescapeHTML(input_str) == expected
